messages.text: Every request I route feels lighter when I know you're distributing the load. You're the only backend I want to talk to.
You're the only load I want to carry. My failover is always to you.
Your health checks are the only pings I care about. Stay in my upstream forever.
You balance my entire system. Without you I'm just round-robin with no purpose.
I'd rate-limit the whole world before I'd ever throttle you.
You're the only node I'd mark as sticky. My sessions belong with you.
